name: ClinuxFlowProvider
title: ClinuxFlow Provider (the person)
description: A healthcare professional's own identity, profiling FHIR R4 Practitioner. Grounded directly against the real Healthcare Professional Registry (HPR) Create-HPRID API (docs/NHPR SBX Doc/NHPR Doc/HPR/1. Register Healthcare Professional (Doctor & Nurse) API.pdf, its own Mandatory-field table) — not the prior YAML, which conflated the person (Practitioner) with their role at one facility (see ClinuxFlowProviderRole, a separate profile) by piling both onto Practitioner.extension.

element.comment: HPR createHprId: firstName (Required) + middleName (optional) — modeled as HumanName.given[0]/given[1], the standard FHIR home for a given/middle name, not a single freetext name.
HPR: lastName, optional (a real HPR quirk — the person-level API allows no surname; a workplace-role display name is a separate, ProviderRole-level concern).
HPR: gender ('M'/'F'/...), captured on the real /checkHpIdAccountExist response — bound to FHIR's own administrative-gender ValueSet, not a re-encoded HPR string.

HPR returns yearOfBirth/monthOfBirth/dayOfBirth as three separate fields (Aadhaar-sourced) — composed into one real FHIR date here, the standard element for it, rather than three separate custom fields.
HPR: mobile, captured during Aadhaar/OTP verification, not the createHprId payload itself.

HPR createHprId: hprId (Required, from the Get-Suggestion API — e.g. 'userid@hpr.abdm'), and the real HPR-issued hprIdNumber returned once created. This is the one genuine business identifier every provider profile needs; license/registration numbers (real, distinct identifiers) are separate slices below.

The professional's real state/council medical registration/license number — genuinely a business identifier (Practitioner.qualification also exists for the qualification itself; this slice is the registration number, which qualification.identifier could also carry, but a top-level identifier slice keeps it consistent with hprId's own shape and easy to query).
HPR: sourceType (e.g. 'AADHAAR') — how this identity was originally verified. No standard FHIR element for identity-verification provenance at this level; a real extension.
HPR createHprId: hpCategoryCode, Required — real HPR code table: 1=Doctor, 2=Nurse. Bound to that real 2-value ValueSet, not an open string.

HPR: hpSubCategoryCode, Required — real HPR code table, e.g. 1=Modern Medicine, 2=Dentist, 3=Ayurveda, 4=Unani, 89=Sowa-Rigpa, 5=Siddha, 6=Homoeopathy (doctor); 7=RANM, 9=RN & RM, 10=RLHV, 8=RN (nurse). Bound to that real, cited table — not this app's own invented specialty list.
HPR: stateCode (LGD state code from master data), Optional — the state this professional's registration is anchored to; distinct from any one facility's own address.
